tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Facts about blicht.com, the bilingual (German/English) knowledge platform for e-commerce, AI and lifestyle: publisher, contact, entry points for further reading and how to fetch pages efficiently as Markdown.

lang.description: Language of the returned content (default: de).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The content map of blicht.com: 3 sections (e-commerce, AI, lifestyle) with their fixed topics, each with a description and the URL of its overview page.

lang.description: Language of the returned content (default: de).

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Full-text search across all blicht.com content (articles, section and topic pages) in German or English. Returns the most relevant pages with title, URL and description so you can cite them. Read-only. Fetch a hit's full text via get_article or by requesting its URL with 'Accept: text/markdown'.

query.description: Keywords or a short question (max 500 characters).

lang.description: Search the German (default) or English index.

max_results.description: Number of results to return (1-8, default 5).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a blicht.com article as clean Markdown. Accepts the article URL (https://blicht.com/beitrag/<slug> or /en/article/<slug>), the path, or a bare slug (combined with lang). Use search_knowledge first to find the right article.

article.description: Article URL, path (/beitrag/<slug> or /en/article/<slug>) or bare slug.

lang.description: Only used with a bare slug: which edition to fetch (default: de).
